observations: Toyota Hilux engine with a manual transmission and a manual gearbox.
The engine is resting on gravel with a black tarp partially covering it.
The engine has a 'V6' badge on the side of the cylinder head.
The engine is missing its original plastic engine cover.
The seller's text mentions '2007' and 'gear box' but the photo does not confirm this.
A watermark 'BLESSED WORLD' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The photo does not show a year stamp or model plate.

risks.risk: The engine may be a used or rebuilt unit rather than a genuine Toyota part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine's identification plate (usually on the side or back).
risks.if_unproven: as a used or rebuilt engine

risks.risk: The gearbox may be missing or in poor condition.
risks.proof: A photo of the gearbox and its shifter assembly.

risks.risk: The engine may have internal damage or be non-running.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a compression test result.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine's identification plate showing the model and year.
Photo of the gearbox and its shifter.
Video of the engine starting and running.
Photo of the engine cover to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
